description: This file contains implementation details for packing objects in a Git repository, such as locating objects, rehashing, preparing packing data, and handling object entries within the pack structures.

methods.name: uint32_t locate_object_entry_hash(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid,int * found)
methods.description: Locates the hash entry for a specific object ID within the packing data index, setting 'found' accordingly.

methods.name: uint32_t closest_pow2(uint32_t v)
methods.description: Calculates the closest power of two greater than or equal to the input value.

methods.name: void rehash_objects(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Rehashes the objects in the packing data to maintain an efficient hash index.

methods.name: struct:object_entry * packlist_find(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Finds an object entry in the packing data based on the object ID.

methods.name: void prepare_in_pack_by_idx(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Prepares in-pack index mappings for the packing data structure.

methods.name: void oe_map_new_pack(struct packing_data * pack)
methods.description: Maps a new pack into the packing data, updating the in_pack array.

methods.name: void prepare_packing_data(struct repository * r,struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Initializes the packing data structure with repository info and configuration.

methods.name: void clear_packing_data(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Frees allocated memory in the packing data structure.

methods.name: struct:object_entry * packlist_alloc(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new object entry within the packing data.

methods.name: void oe_set_delta_ext(struct packing_data * pdata,struct object_entry * delta,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Sets external delta information for an object entry.

ctags.name: locate_object_entry_hash
ctags.signature: (struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid,int * found)

ctags.name: oe_set_delta_ext
ctags.signature: (struct packing_data * pdata,struct object_entry * delta,const struct object_id * oid)
